name: distributed-data-pipeline-qa
description: Playwright test suite validating data integrity across a distributed pipeline (agent -> splitter -> target) that streams and fans out log data over TCP.

scripts.test:graceful: npm run build && npx playwright test data-target-graceful-validation.spec.js
scripts.test:strict: npm run build && npx playwright test data-target-strict-validation.spec.js
scripts.test:report: npm run build && npx playwright test data-analysis-report.spec.js
